devices.name: SW1
devices.cli:
!
hostname SW1
!
spanning-tree mode pvst
vlan 10
 name COMPTA
!
vlan 20
 name COMMERCIAL
!
vlan 30
 name SERVEURS
!
interface FastEthernet0/1
 switchport access vlan 10
 switchport mode access
!
interface FastEthernet0/2
 switchport access vlan 30
 switchport mode access
!
interface FastEthernet0/24
 switchport mode trunk
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 switchport mode trunk
!
line con 0
 logging synchronous
line vty 0 4
!

devices.name: R1
devices.cli:
!
hostname R1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 no ip address
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 no ip address
 shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 no ip address
 shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.10
 encapsulation dot1Q 10
 ip address 192.168.10.1 255.255.255.0
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.20
 encapsulation dot1Q 20
 ip address 192.168.20.1 255.255.255.0
 ip access-group COMMERCIAL-IN in
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.30
 encapsulation dot1Q 3
 ip address 192.168.30.1 255.255.255.0
!
ip access-list extended COMMERCIAL-IN
 deny ip 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255
 permit ip any any
!
line con 0
 logging synchronous
line vty 0 4
!
devices.startup:
!
hostname R1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 no ip address
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 no ip address
 shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 no ip address
 shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.10
 encapsulation dot1Q 10

!

!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.30

!

line con 0
 logging synchronous
line vty 0 4
!

notes: Terminale S05 – La PME Rivière marchait, puis un collègue a modifié trois choses : le trunk de SW2 n'autorise plus le VLAN 20, la sous-interface Gi0/0.30 a une mauvaise encapsulation, le serveur a une mauvaise passerelle. À dépanner.
